blocks.x: That button makes a difference between pulling it back into a machine, which I recorded my machine to, and speaking now.
This machine now is recording, because it's showing recording. I should be playing back, but there's something about the back -- something wrong with the playback.
Let's start again and try it again. But first I want to be sure this is working, so we don't have any more trouble, so we don't have to stop.
